notes:
# Orvio 0.40

- TV sign-in works with the remote straight away: the button and the e-mail field are selected when the screen opens, and Back returns from the e-mail form to the code screen.
- The e-mail field shows the e-mail keyboard (with @).
- Finished films leave "Recently watched". Watching a film or episode again brings it back until you finish it.
- The Trailer button on TV series pages is no longer hidden behind the episode list.
- Buttons with ♡ or ✓ are now the same height as the others.
- Picture and sound badges in the player line up neatly on the right.
- Profiles pop in and lift with a warm glow when selected; the phone banner button and page dots have a smoother look.
- Live TV stops retrying after three quick failures instead of retrying forever.
- Security: signing out now also ends your session on the server, a TV code that could not be used no longer leaves a session behind, and the "Sign in a TV" screen warns to only use a code from your own TV.
